'''SE-2-4''', also known as '''Twofour''', was an [[SE-2-4 servant droid]] in the service of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Vaskel Savill]]. Savill treated the droid poorly, and continuously insulted the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. SE-2-4 was ashamed of being treated that way.<ref name="LE" />
